{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRkquM8AAAABZkeHcQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5zhDLEmg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5", "number": 93, "title": "Resolve S-DSP BRR filter 1–3 arithmetic and block-history conformance", "body": "## Problem

BRR filters 1–3 have implementation but insufficient independent evidence. At baseline `c19d29c8cc9afecf92f894ef67814e0cb5626309`, [`Dsp::decode`](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/c19d29c8cc9afecf92f894ef67814e0cb5626309/crates/snes-core/src/dsp.rs#L70-L123) implements signed expansion, predictor arithmetic, saturation, wrapping and two-sample history. Its direct numerical BRR test covers filter 0; the directory, terminal-header and KON-preload diagnostics also construct filter-0 blocks.

Filter 0 cannot expose incorrect predictor rounding, history ordering or history resets. In particular, KON priming decodes twelve samples ahead of the selected interpolation window, so predictor history and audible-window history intentionally differ. Existing filter-0 coverage cannot establish that predictor-dependent continuation is correct.

The supplied latest assessment identifies this investigation as the next prerequisite. Inspection has not demonstrated an arithmetic defect, so this Issue must establish independent evidence before prescribing production changes. It does not repeat the completed #89 priming or #91 envelope corrections.

## Expected outcome

Establish independently derived BRR filter 1–3 arithmetic and stream-continuity expectations, then implement any demonstrated corrections within that scope. If the baseline satisfies the complete bounded matrix, retain its implementation and document that result; do not manufacture a production change.

Use the hardware research references already attributed by the repository:

- [Anomie/jwdonal revision 1212](https://gist.github.com/nyanpasu64/a0d916ce6924912a7116682bf778e9a0#file-apudsp_jwdonal-txt), **BRR DECODING**, including predictor arithmetic, history and initialization.
- [Fullsnes BRR Samples](https://problemkaputt.de/fullsnes.htm#snesapudspbrrsamples), **BRR Decoding**, range handling and block progression.
- Repository source reconciliation and bounded API mapping in [#89](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/c19d29c8cc9afecf92f894ef67814e0cb5626309/docs/issue-89-validation.md#source-reconciliation) and [#91](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/c19d29c8cc9afecf92f894ef67814e0cb5626309/docs/issue-91-validation.md#source-reconciliation-and-implementation-boundary).

Reconcile the following candidate full-amplitude arithmetic contract against those specification sections before using it as an oracle. External specification pages were not fetched during this repository-only planning pass.

Let `n` be the signed four-bit nibble, `r` the range, `P` the preceding full-amplitude decoded sample, and `Q` the second preceding sample arithmetically shifted right once. Let `ASR` mean arithmetic right shift, `C16` signed-16 saturation and `W16` signed-16 wrapping:

```text
B = ASR(n * 2^r, 1)                  when r <= 12
B = -2048 when n < 0, otherwise 0    when r >= 13

filter 0: T = B
filter 1: T = B + ASR(P,1) + ASR(-P,5)
filter 2: T = B + P - Q + ASR(Q,4) + ASR(-3*P,6)
filter 3: T = B + P - Q + ASR(-13*P,7) + ASR(3*Q,4)

decoded_full = W16(2 * C16(T))
```

The core stores half-amplitude history, so prove the representation conversion explicitly. Preserve separately rounded terms; approximate coefficients or a single combined division are insufficient. Feed the wrapped decoded result into subsequent history. Ordinary sequential and loop-directed block transitions must preserve predictor history, including when the next header changes filter or range.

If the references disagree with this candidate contract or an earlier Issue contract, record the exact disagreement and evidence-based resolution before changing expectations. Repository code and passing tests are not specification authority.

## Context and reproduction

Inspect `Voice::history`, `Dsp::decode`, the KON preload queue and its consumption in `Dsp::sample`. Relevant existing tests are:

- `dsp.rs::tests::brr_filter_zero_sign_range_and_loop_are_numerical` and `terminal_tests`.
- `crates/snes-core/tests/dsp_kon_preload.rs`.
- `crates/snes-core/tests/dsp_directory.rs` and `dsp_brr_end.rs`.
- `crates/snes-core/tests/dsp_envelope_order.rs` for preceding-envelope output and downstream consumers.

Reproduce the evidence gap with original predictor-dependent blocks and independently derived decoded sequences, then compare public PCM/register results through stable-register `Dsp` and uploaded-SPC paths. This planning pass inspected source only; no suites were rerun.

Scope is stable-input BRR arithmetic, per-voice predictor continuity, and continuation from the existing twelve-sample preload. Exclude DSP subcycle scheduling, physical decode lookahead/publication timing, live initialization races, KON predictor-retention semantics, the NON advancement dispute, new interpolation algorithms, firmware, UI and enhancement chips.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record specification sections, signed widths, shift grouping, saturation/wrap order and half/full-amplitude equivalence. Resolve conflicting requirements explicitly; distinguish documented hardware facts from this core's sample-call conventions.
- [ ] Add original numerical tests for filters 1–3 covering all sixteen nibbles and all sixteen ranges over a bounded set of valid history pairs: zero, both signs, unequal/reversed predecessors, small rounding-sensitive values and signed endpoints. Include separate positive/negative saturation cases and 15-bit wrapping without saturation. Freeze independently derived anchor values with worked calculations; do not obtain expectations from production helpers or emulator traces.
- [ ] Add original stream vectors crossing sequential and end+loop boundaries, including filter/range changes and at least two loop traversals. Assert decoded samples and both predictor-history entries. Distinguish preserved history from zeroed, swapped, stale and cross-voice history.
- [ ] Exercise predictor-dependent continuation across the twelve-sample KON preload boundary, including zero-pitch hold followed by resume. Demonstrate that queued samples are neither decoded twice nor substituted for the decoder's newest history. Preserve the five silent calls, first selected window and preceding-envelope behavior established by #89/#91.
- [ ] Add `crates/snes-core/tests/dsp_brr_filters.rs` with public-API PCM/OUTX anchors for each predictor filter and an original uploaded SPC700 guest using `$F2/$F3`. Bound upload/acknowledgement waits. Assert specification-derived numeric records and PCM independently in each run before comparing whole versus irregular APU tick partitions; partition equality alone establishes determinism.
- [ ] Run the new tests against the exact baseline and candidate. For each production correction, report a baseline behavioral failure and corrected pass. If no mismatch exists, report that explicitly and retain the decoder. Do not weaken existing expectations to obtain passes.
- [ ] Run `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --locked` and `cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test dsp_brr_filters`. Preserve filter-0, KON, directory, terminal-header, envelope, PMON, noise, mixing and echo regressions.
- [ ] Run the existing README/CI source-built gates: `python3 tools/build-test-tools.py --spc`; `python3 tools/hardware-tests.py --ca65 "$PWD/.cache/tools/cc65/bin/ca65" --ld65 "$PWD/.cache/tools/cc65/bin/ld65" --spcasm "$PWD/.cache/tools/spcasm/target/release/spcasm"`; and `python3 tools/ppu-test.py --bass "$PWD/.cache/tools/bass-untech/bass/out/bass-untech"`.
- [ ] Complete the README browser prerequisites, rebuild the cleared games twice, run `npm --prefix web ci`, `npm --prefix web run build`, and from `web` run `npm test -- --grep-invert '301 seconds'`. Preserve Castle/Memory gameplay, route, audio and queue assertions, source pins, hashes and licensing decisions. Report failures, skips and unperformed checks accurately.
- [ ] Document original authorship/licensing of new guest bytes, BRR data and vectors in `tests/roms/PROVENANCE.md`. Use only original or explicitly licensed source-built fixtures; acquire no commercial ROMs or firmware.
- [ ] Preserve all 24 inventory categories and their full supplied scopes: 22 partial, `ppu-raster` and `pal` unimplemented, none verified. Retain the [inherited inventory](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/c19d29c8cc9afecf92f894ef67814e0cb5626309/docs/issue-81-validation.md#inventory-and-remaining-limits) together with subsequent corrections. Specifically retain outstanding interpolation-phase coverage, simultaneous key/mixing combinations, KON history/selection questions, physical header/key/directory/publication timing, register/RAM races and reset retention. These bounded checks establish neither complete hardware accuracy nor commercial compatibility and do not complete Issue #3.

## Optional validation

None.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
